reason: I already have my POS and a QR menu, and my staff won't learn a second system for a startup that may be gone next year. Three free months doesn't help me if I have to rip it all out later and lose my regulars' details.
objection: Who is behind this, will it still exist in a year, and who owns my guest list if they close or sell it? Plus there's another payment fee on top of what I already pay.
would_change_my_mind: If it plugged straight into my existing POS so staff do nothing new, and the contract said in writing that I own my guest data and can export it whenever I want.
